Title: Bob C. and his Furry Friend

Messages.Author: MarcusVitel
Messages.Body:
Greetings,

The rules say that allies can ‘ignore all burn blood effects’. Please clarify:
1. I can employ Robert Carter with my Renegade Rarou, correct ?
2. How much do I pay for successfully employing the retainer and during the untap phase?

Thanks

-MV-

Messages.Author: Lech
Messages.Body:
1. No, 1 blood cost is required to employ. Allies don't have blood.

Sabbat.Black Hand Shakar: Lech loathe ranged weapons. Once each action, he may burn 1 blood to become Camarilla Prince of Krakow until the end of the action.
